nonBlockingIssues.description: Duplicate 'Color Theme' label in preferences appearance tab caused during AppearanceTabParams extraction.

Commit includes significant scope creep: shader contract changes, dead code removal, widget default sizes from another feature, and editor handler method extraction — all intermingled with the parameter struct work.
Per-frame Vec allocation for visible entities in hierarchy.rs. Acceptable for typical use case.
Magic number 4.0 padding in ListView content height calculation.
Subtle ordering dependency in on_mouse_input calling handle_editor_mouse_press then handle_editor_mouse_release.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the paired editor/non-editor module file pattern (editor_methods.rs / no_editor_methods.rs) as a convention for reducing cfg annotation noise in katla_app.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature reduce-cfg-editor-and-widget-sizes established this pattern, reducing 22 per-method cfg pairs to 2 file-level module gates.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the dual-source widget default pattern: new() uses compile-time DEFAULTS const, at_cursor() uses runtime ui.style fields. Future workers adding new widgets should follow this pattern.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Features create-listview-widget and reduce-cfg-editor-and-widget-sizes both use this pattern. Two reviewers independently flagged it as undocumented.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add guidance that popup blocking for click interactions works at the press phase (pre-computed hover) and the popup_aware flag only differentiates release-phase behavior. This nuance is important for future workers modifying click handling.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature unify-click-handling — the popup blocking mechanism is subtle and undocumented.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document that Mat3 internal storage is row-major (each Vec3 is a row, not a column), which is unusual for graphics code. from_rows() was renamed from from_elements() to be explicit.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature audit-too-many-arguments — the worker renamed from_elements to from_rows to clarify the layout.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add doc-test commands: 'test_katla_ecs_doc: cargo test --doc -p katla_ecs' and 'test_katla_app_doc: cargo test --doc -p katla_app' for features that modify documentation examples.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature pool-vello-rendercontext-and-fix-doctests needed these but they weren't available in services.yaml.

rejectedObservations.observation: ClickConfig uses pub visibility inside pub(crate) struct
rejectedObservations.reason: Cosmetic consistency issue. pub within pub(crate) is equivalent to pub(crate). Not worth adding a normative rule for.

rejectedObservations.observation: Mixed import path styles (relative vs absolute) for ClickConfig
rejectedObservations.reason: Minor style inconsistency. Both patterns work and are idiomatic Rust. Not worth enforcing a rule.

rejectedObservations.observation: No new services needed for reduce-cfg-editor-and-widget-sizes
rejectedObservations.reason: Informational only — no action needed since existing services cover all verification commands.

rejectedObservations.observation: Widget default size work completed by concurrent workers rather than this feature's sessions
rejectedObservations.reason: Informational about workflow dynamics, not a knowledge gap or convention issue.

rejectedObservations.observation: Commit interleaving between create-listview-widget and reduce-cfg-editor-and-widget-sizes
rejectedObservations.reason: Same issue as audit-too-many-arguments scope creep. Already captured in nonBlockingIssues.

rejectedObservations.observation: Verification command rg RenderContext::new checks file location not behavior
rejectedObservations.reason: Valid criticism of the original feature's verification steps, but not actionable for shared state. Would need a new test to properly verify pool behavior.
Already documented in the glyph_pool.rs source code. Adding to library would be redundant with the implementation itself.

rejectedObservations.observation: The closure-based acquire pattern is a good Rust pattern for scoped borrowing from pools
rejectedObservations.reason: Implementation detail already visible in the source code. Not a cross-cutting convention that needs separate documentation.
